overall_summary: Analysis of 11 RISE MODE videos published between Sept 3 and Sept 6, 2026 shows top performance clustered around themes of transforming pain into power and upgrading effort, published around 11:00-14:00 UTC. Due to the small sample size (4 days of data), confidence levels are low to medium, requiring further testing.

what_is_working.evidence: Titles featuring 'Turn Your Pain Into Power' achieved the highest engagement (1,155 views, 76 likes, 3 comments on Sept 3; 889 views, 43 likes on Sept 5).
what_is_working.action: Double down on emotional transformation themes using direct action verbs (e.g., Turn, Reclaim, Forge).

what_is_working.evidence: Videos posted in this window consistently achieved 829 to 1,155 views across multiple days.
what_is_working.action: Schedule high-priority Shorts uploads between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM UTC.

what_to_improve.evidence: Video uploaded at 16:23 UTC ('Activate Your RISE MODE') generated only 9 views and 0 likes.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid late afternoon (post-16:00 UTC) slots until channel audience grows or additional data suggests otherwise.

what_to_improve.pattern: Generic title hooks without strong emotional hooks or explicit '#Shorts' tag
what_to_improve.evidence: Generic title 'Activate Your RISE MODE | Powerful Mindset Motivation' achieved 9 views, whereas specific action titles with '#Shorts' averaged 800+ views.
what_to_improve.action: Ensure every title includes a specific emotional friction point, high-contrast hook, and the '#Shorts' hashtag.
